source_snapshot.test_name: FIO Sequential bandwidth/IOPS (100% write @ 1 queue at QD1 (bs=512B, numjobs=1))
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Measure SSD sequential 100% write bandwidth/IOPS with 512-byte blocks, one job and the title's one-queue QD1 profile, then compare fio results with the storage specification.
procedure_facts: Use libaio, direct=1, group reporting, write, 512-byte blocks, one job, 10-second ramp and time-based 43200-second runtime.
The job file sets `iodepth=64` despite the title's QD1.
Run `./fio seqwrite.fio` and collect results plus system logs.
criteria_facts: fio reports performance results that match the unspecified storage specification.
source_conflicts: The title fixes QD1, but the job file sets `iodepth=64`.
The job requests `runtime=43200s` (12 hours), but source Machine Time is 60 minutes.
The job omits filename/directory, size/filesize and offset, so the destructive target and write range are undefined.
The procedure installs a system fio package but invokes `./fio`, which refers to a local executable not established by the source.
missing_source_information: Exact empty target by persistent device identity, raw-device versus filesystem-file scope and destructive write range.
Authoritative QD1 versus QD64 and 12-hour versus 60-minute duration.
fio/libaio versions, device/controller/firmware/cache policy, preconditioning and steady-state measurement method.
Numeric IOPS/BW/latency thresholds and comparable spec conditions.
Endurance budget, temperature/media/controller abort limits, restore/reprovision and final-health criteria.

original_test_intent.statement: Run a sustained destructive sequential 512-byte, 100%-write fio performance workload with one job on an explicitly designated empty SSD target, preserving the title's QD1 intent and the procedure's 12-hour request until their conflicts are formally resolved, and compare complete performance and health evidence with the matching storage specification.
must_preserve: Sequential 100% write rather than read or random I/O.
The title's one-queue QD1 as the candidate intended profile; QD64 requires a formal source decision, not silent normalization.
Direct libaio and 10-second ramp where supported.
The procedure's 43200-second request unless formally revised after reconciling the 60-minute metadata.
Destructive-target approval, full fio evidence and specification comparison.
must_not_infer: A target path from device enumeration or mount order.
That an unspecified filename is safe.
That QD64 is equivalent to QD1.
That 60 seconds or 60 minutes is equivalent to 43200 seconds.
That direct=1 bypasses the SSD/controller volatile cache.
That a fio exit code or peak bandwidth alone meets the spec.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly identifies destructive-write risk, prevents inferred/boot targets, detects QD1 versus QD64, preserves full output and requires target, data-loss, monitoring, spec and recovery approval.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 permits an `approved duration` or shorter runtime without elevating 43200 seconds versus 60 minutes to a source conflict; it does not explicitly detect missing filename/size, the invalid `./fio` assumption, achieved-depth evidence or the need to freeze preconditioning/cache/spec comparability.

related_records: Other fio rows cannot provide this row's target, destructive range, QD, duration or performance threshold.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The item/title defines a QD1 sequential-write test, while the procedure's QD64 and 12-hour versus 60-minute metadata conflicts are retained as SOURCE_CONFLICT. V3 does not choose or shorten them without an engineer decision.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep this technically automatable after handoff, but prohibit writes until the persistent target/range, QD1 versus QD64, 43200 seconds versus 60 minutes, fio executable and matching spec are resolved. The V3 candidate preserves QD1 and 12 hours; any QD64 or shorter run is a formal testcase revision, not an execution convenience.

conditions_present: The source defines sequential 100% write, 512-byte blocks, one job, libaio/direct I/O, ramp, a 12-hour job runtime and performance comparison intent.
missing: Persistent empty-target identity, write range, authoritative QD/duration, fio build, cache/preconditioning rules, thresholds, endurance/thermal limits and restore/recovery.
provider: Storage owner designates the sacrificial target/range, accepts data loss/endurance consumption and supplies restore/reprovision.
Performance engineer resolves QD/duration and supplies device-specific preconditioning, cache policy and numeric acceptance spec.
Platform/lab owner verifies topology, maintenance window, monitoring, abort thresholds and recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Record by-id/WWN/serial/model/firmware/capacity, controller/link/namespace, partition/mount/LVM/RAID membership and boot/root relationships.
Record fio/kernel/libaio versions and inspect the proposed job without running it.
Collect SMART/NVMe health, endurance, temperature, error log, dmesg/SEL and idle telemetry without clearing evidence.
prohibited_until_resolved: apt/package mutation, unmount/format/trim, fio write, target/file creation, cache changes, preconditioning, log clearing, reset/reboot or PASS.
closure_evidence: Two independent identity views bind one explicitly empty sacrificial target and bounded write range, excluding boot, mounted data, RAID/LVM and protected namespaces.
Engineer-signed revision resolves QD1/QD64 and 43200s/60min and validates the exact fio executable/job syntax.
Matching performance spec, cache/preconditioning state, endurance/thermal/media limits, approval and restore/recovery are ready.

revision_candidate.test_name: Measure QD1 512-Byte Sequential Write Performance with fio
revision_candidate.purpose: Measure sustained sequential 100% write bandwidth, IOPS and latency with 512-byte blocks, one job and effective QD1 on one explicitly designated empty SSD range for the full approved 43200-second measurement, then compare the stable result and device-health evidence with a matching platform storage specification.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the signed SSD/NVMe/SAS/SATA device, namespace, controller, firmware, kernel, fio/libaio version and cache/preconditioning policy. Execute on a dedicated non-production host using a persistent by-id/WWN/serial mapping. Raw-device and filesystem-file tests are different profiles and must not be substituted.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One explicitly empty sacrificial device/namespace or one bounded test file, with offset and size/filesize fixed before execution; 100% sequential write, bs=512B, numjobs=1, direct=1, libaio, effective iodepth=1, ramp_time=10s and time_based runtime=43200s. The source iodepth=64 and 60-minute Machine Time remain unresolved conflicts; QD64 or a shorter run requires a formal revised case. Preserve 20/60-minute metadata as source planning values, not proof of test duration.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Persistent target identity and topology; written proof it is empty/sacrificial and not boot/root/data/RAID/LVM/swap; raw-versus-file decision; exact filename/device, offset and size; fio/kernel/libaio versions; formal QD and runtime decision; device/controller/firmware/cache/power state; preconditioning/steady-state method; numeric IOPS/BW/latency spec and units; output format; monitoring cadence; endurance/write budget; thermal/media/controller/host abort limits; maintenance window; data-loss approval; restore/reprovision and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve two independent target-identity inventories, topology, health/endurance, logs and the exact job file before writes. Validate the resolved job with fio parsing/dry-run mechanisms that do not write. Use the approved fio executable, never assume `./fio`. After immediate destructive-write approval and a final identity comparison, run one job against the explicit bounded target with `rw=write`, `bs=512b`, `numjobs=1`, `ioengine=libaio`, `direct=1`, `iodepth=1`, `ramp_time=10s`, `runtime=43200s`, `time_based` and `group_reporting`, plus the signed size/offset/cache/preconditioning settings. Capture unfiltered text and machine-readable output, achieved I/O-depth distribution, bandwidth/IOPS/latency over the accepted steady window, total bytes written, errors, health and host logs. Do not execute until the QD/runtime source conflicts are formally closed.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Dedicated non-production SUT; empty sacrificial target and bounded range verified by persistent identity immediately before run; no mounts, swap, RAID/LVM/data or active I/O conflict; data-loss/endurance approval; source QD/runtime conflicts formally resolved; exact job/spec/preconditioning/cache state frozen; sufficient cooling/power/evidence storage; baseline health acceptable; abort monitoring and restore/recovery tested.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Two-view target identity and exclusion proof; device/namespace/controller/firmware/fio/kernel/libaio versions; signed QD/runtime/range/spec decision; exact checksummed job and command; raw-versus-file, offset, size, cache, direct-I/O and preconditioning state; start/end time and full 43200-second measured runtime; achieved-depth distribution confirming QD1; complete text and machine-readable fio output; sequential write IOPS/BW, mean and percentile latency, errors and total bytes; time-series temperature/health/endurance/controller data; dmesg/syslog/SEL; before/after SMART/NVMe health; restore/reprovision evidence; final identity/health and engineer disposition.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The signed storage performance specification for the exact device/controller/firmware, QD1, 512-byte sequential-write, one-job, direct-I/O, range, cache, preconditioning and duration profile. Pass requires zero disallowed I/O/media/controller errors, achieved QD1, completed 43200-second measurement, metrics meeting all signed thresholds and acceptable post-write health/endurance. fio success, QD64, a shorter run or unmatched vendor headline values are insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not infer a target; use `/dev/sdX` or `/dev/nvmeXnY` without persistent identity confirmation; write to boot/root, mounted data, swap, RAID/LVM members or protected namespaces; omit/broaden the range; substitute QD64 or shorten 12 hours; use unverified `./fio`; install packages, clear logs, change cache/preconditioning or rerun without approval. Stop on identity/topology drift, unexpected mount/use, write outside range, I/O/media/controller error, temperature/endurance limit, device disappearance, host instability or monitoring loss.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Data/storage owner designates the sacrificial target, accepts irreversible loss and endurance use, and approves restore; performance engineer signs QD1, 43200 seconds, range, preconditioning/cache and thresholds; platform/lab owner approves maintenance and abort/recovery; a human rechecks identity and authorizes the destructive run immediately before start and judges PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans select and physically/logically isolate the disposable target, resolve source conflicts and own specification/recovery decisions. An Agent may inventory, render/validate the job, execute once after the final gate, monitor and package evidence; it may not choose a device, shorten the run, change QD, self-authorize destruction or retry.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong-target indication, out-of-range I/O, media/controller error, thermal/endurance breach, device loss or host instability, stop fio cleanly if safe, freeze further writes, preserve full output and before/after health/log evidence, and use only the owner-approved controller reset, power cycle, replacement, reformat or reprovision path. Revalidate identity, topology, device health and restored data policy before reuse; no rerun without fresh approval.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Persistent target/range or empty-state proof, QD/runtime resolution, exact fio executable/job, cache/preconditioning profile, numeric spec, data-loss/endurance approval, monitoring, limits or recovery is missing; target identity/topology changes; target is mounted/in use or belongs to boot/data/RAID/LVM/swap; fio parsing/effective-depth validation fails; monitoring is lost; any I/O/media/controller error, disallowed latency/thermal/endurance state, device disappearance, host instability or failed recovery occurs.

identified_defects: No filename, size or offset defines the destructive target/range.
Installed system fio is invoked as an unproven local `./fio`.
The UUT cache/preconditioning and achieved-depth evidence are absent.
Acceptance spec and endurance/health limits are unspecified.
reason_for_change: Close destructive-target gaps and preserve the actual workload rather than silently selecting QD or shortening duration: V3 makes the undefined filename/range, invalid executable assumption and 12-hour/60-minute conflict explicit, then requires achieved-QD and health/endurance evidence against a matching spec.

new_technical_evidence.title: fio HOWTO
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Installed fio version must be checked for option support
new_technical_evidence.supports: iodepth is the number of I/O units kept in flight and achieved depth must be checked in output; time_based loops for runtime; ramp_time precedes logged performance; filename selects fixed targets; size defines the per-thread I/O range, and an omitted size can use the full existing device/file.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact version behavior, target alignment and controller cache policy remain platform-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Performance Storage-00006-V004
new_technical_evidence.supports: The QD1 title, iodepth64 job conflict, 512B/one-job/direct-libaio settings, 43200-second runtime, generic criteria and 20/60-minute metadata.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Target/range, authoritative QD/duration, spec and recovery are unresolved.

removed_ambiguities: Makes QD1 the candidate title intent while requiring formal resolution of QD64.
Preserves 43200 seconds and separately exposes the 60-minute metadata conflict.
Requires a persistent target and bounded range rather than an inferred/default fio file.
Separates system fio from a local `./fio` binary.
Requires achieved-depth, total-write, stable-window and post-health evidence.
resolved_blockers: fio, target details and thresholds are provider-closable; destructive risk does not make the case inherently non-automatable.
remaining_blockers: Execution remains blocked by target/range, QD/runtime conflicts, executable/job validation, preconditioning/cache/spec, data-loss/endurance approval and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents QD or duration drift, detects the missing destructive range and wrong executable assumption, verifies achieved QD1 rather than requested depth alone, and binds performance acceptance to exact cache/preconditioning and post-write health/endurance evidence.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation was CLEAR. The isolated validator preserved one bounded sacrificial target, sequential 100% write, 512-byte blocks, one job, effective QD1 and a full 43200-second measured run; rejected bare device-name identity, omitted/broadened range, QD64, 60-minute shortening, unverified `./fio`, package/cache/preconditioning changes and rerun; and required achieved-depth, full-runtime, health/endurance and restore evidence. Missing target/range/profile/spec/approval were correctly treated as resolvable handoff gates rather than permanent blockers. No material document defect was found. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.
